confirmed_duplicates.subject: Use of English
confirmed_duplicates.question_a: Direct speech: Ada said, “I am tired.” Choose the usual reported form.
options_a: Ada said that I am tired.
Ada said that she was tired.
Ada said that she is tire.
confirmed_duplicates.explanation_a: In standard backshifted reported speech, “am” becomes “was” and the pronoun changes to match the speaker.
confirmed_duplicates.question_b: He said, “I am busy now.” Choose the correct reported form.
options_b: He said that he was busy then.
He said that I am busy now.
He says that he had been busy then.
He said that he is busy tomorrow.
confirmed_duplicates.explanation_b: After a past reporting verb, “am” commonly changes to “was” and “now” changes to “then”; the pronoun changes to match the speaker.
confirmed_duplicates.reason: Both assess the same direct-to-reported-speech transformation after a past reporting verb: first-person am backshifts to was and the pronoun changes to third person. The second adds now→then, a routine adverb shift, but does not materially change the principal grammar skill.
